messages:
Leah (People Ops): Heads up 1 1 new manager join next Monday (Evelyn Park). I drafted a compact day0 -> week1 checklist focused on managers(tech + people ops). Add anything we miss. Short version below.
Evelyn Park: Thank you! Quick Qs: laptop day 0? who sets up GitHub org access and SSH? and can I get a buddy for infra?
Ivy (IT): If procurement form submitted by Thu we can image laptop for Day 0. For access we do Okta/GSuite + GitHub org invite. Please open a ticket with this template (copy/paste):
```
Title: New manager laptop + access - Evelyn Park
Body:
- Start date: 2026-05-04
- Team: Eng - Runtime
- Device preference: Macbook Pro 14 / Existing device: None
- Access needed: Okta/GSuite, GitHub org (write), AWS staging, Vault (read), SSH key registration
- Manager approver: Nikhil R.
```
Ivy (IT): Also include whether you need HSM/KMS admin rights. For SSH: generate key locally and add to settings.github.com/new -> or we can register for you if you paste the public key.
Jordan (Infra): Happy to be buddy first week for infra walkthroughs and demo envs. Day2 I can show the staging cluster, deploy flow, and how batching/caching configs live in repo.
Nikhil R.: From leadership side: please post a 30/60/90 draft before EOD Friday so we can set priorities. My expectations: 30d - ramp and TL meetups; 60d - lead one small milestone + stabilize a customer flow; 90d - ship measurable perf or reliability win. We'll sync OKRs wk2.
Leah (People Ops): Day0 -> Week1 checklist (compact):
- Day0: device handed or pickup, Okta + GSuite invite, enroll MFA, GitHub invite sent
- Day1: 30m 1:1 with manager + access verification, quick security briefing, SSH key registered
- Day2: infra buddy walkthrough, staging demo, request short demo pool if needed
- Day3: pair on a small triage task, meet product & SRE leads
- Day4: draft 30/60/90 + get feedback, add calendar blocks for 1:1s
- Day5: ownership task kickoff + retro of week1, confirm additional access (KMS/Vault)
Leah (People Ops): Ticket trackers: procurement -> #it-procurement, infra requests -> #eng-infra, access approvals tracked in PR #infra-access.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager - Onboarding Day 0" invited: evelyn.park@redwood.com.
Evelyn Park: Ok MFA done. I pasted my SSH pubkey in the ticket. Small ask: how to request a short-lived staging pool for demos?
Jordan (Infra): File a short request in #eng-infra with: purpose, region, replicas, retention (hours). For demos < 2 hours I can approve fast path.
Ivy (IT): GitHub invite sent. If you do not see it, check spam and Okta account status. For prod access you'll need manager approval and a brief justification in the infra form.
Nikhil R.: One more: spend 1 hour reading runbooks: /docs/oncall and /docs/deploy-flow. Cuts down front-loaded questions.
Leah (People Ops): Great 44d I'll confirm device ETA and close the procurement ticket once we have the serial #. Evelyn - please drop your 30/60/90 draft here when you have it and tag Nikhil and Jordan. Good luck and welcome! :tada:
